# Size and origin

English | [中文](SIZE-AND-ORIGIN.zh.md)

<!-- Generated numbers: every count on this page sits inside an N marker with a stable key. The generator refills them at export time from the origin count. Do not edit the numbers by hand. -->

Read this before you decide that this repository is a fork with a new name. It says how much of the tree is inherited, how much this project changed or added, and how much is shipped as binary files without their source. All counts are for the <!--N:tree.entries-->21,122<!--/N--> entries of this tree.

## The short answer

This project started from DeepSeek Harness, an MIT-licensed agent runtime. Its notice is kept in [`LICENSES/MIT-DeepSeek-Harness.txt`](../LICENSES/MIT-DeepSeek-Harness.txt). Its plugin framework, Cordis, is vendored as source in [`vendor/`](../vendor/README.md).

- **Most of the tree is inherited.** <!--N:all.unchanged.files-->19,873<!--/N--> of <!--N:all.files-->21,122<!--/N--> entries (<!--N:all.unchanged.files.pct-->94.1<!--/N-->%) are inherited files that this project did not change. Some of them had names, links or placeholders rewritten at publication (see [How it was counted](#how-it-was-counted)). Of the text lines (vendored code left out), <!--N:all.inherited.pct-->88.2<!--/N-->% are inherited.
- **This project's own text is about a tenth.** <!--N:all.own.lines-->313,783<!--/N--> of <!--N:all.text.lines-->2,657,036<!--/N--> text lines (<!--N:all.own.pct-->11.8<!--/N-->%) were changed or added by this project. Counting only source code, it is <!--N:code.own.lines-->268,555<!--/N--> of <!--N:code.text.lines-->1,830,883<!--/N--> lines (<!--N:code.own.pct-->14.7<!--/N-->%).
- **Most of `packages/` is the inherited runtime.** <!--N:top.packages.unchanged.files-->10,814<!--/N--> of its <!--N:top.packages.files-->11,324<!--/N--> files are unchanged, and <!--N:top.packages.own.pct-->6.8<!--/N-->% of its text lines are this project's.
- **Some of this project's work ships without source.** <!--N:all.prebuilt.files-->28<!--/N--> files (<!--N:all.prebuilt.bytes-->7,608,265<!--/N--> bytes, <!--N:all.prebuilt.bytes.pct-->4.5<!--/N-->% of the tree's bytes) are compiled files whose source is not in this repository: <!--N:prebuilt.cells.files-->24<!--/N--> of the <!--N:cells.wasm.files-->25<!--/N--> WebAssembly cells, `pentora36.wasm`, and the <!--N:prebuilt.dakini.files-->3<!--/N--> files of the Dakini Code bundle (one of the stock apps in `apps/web/public/assets/stock-apps/`). See [Binary files without source](#binary-files-without-source).
- **The project's own layer is in a few places.** Six folders hold <!--N:ownlayer.lines-->158,507<!--/N--> lines, <!--N:ownlayer.pct-of-own-->50.5<!--/N-->% of all the project's own lines. They are listed in the next section.

Maturity of these numbers: UNVERIFIED. The project counted them once from its own history before publication, which is not public. Nobody else has run the count. INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED: nothing on this page has that label. What a reader can check is in [What you can reproduce](#what-you-can-reproduce).

## Where this project's own layer lives

None of the files in these six folders comes from the upstream project. Every text line in them is this project's.

Two words first. Auma, the personal AI this project builds, is made of small replaceable modules; the project calls each one an organ. A set of organs is stored as one content-addressed bundle, which the project calls a ball.

| Folder | What is in it | Files | Text lines |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| [`deploy/cloudflare/src/`](../deploy/cloudflare/src/) | The code that runs on Cloudflare's edge, where the owner's passkey is checked: passkey and device checks (`aumlok.mjs`, `passkey-devices.mjs`), the owner-grant policy (`owner-grant-policy.mjs`), the bounded grant one passkey can give for ordinary organ changes (`night-grant.mjs`), the vault and rescue kit (`vault.mjs`, `rescue-kit.mjs`), and their tests in `__tests__/`. | <!--N:own.edge.files-->166<!--/N--> | <!--N:own.edge.text.lines-->75,790<!--/N--> |
| [`server/`](../server/) | The local host and the rules it applies, with their tests: ball heads (`ball-head.mjs`, `ball-transition.mjs`), owner grants (`owner-grant.mjs`), the fixed rules behind Aura, her coherence reading (`aura-rules.mjs`: deterministic, non-authoritative scoring). | <!--N:own.server.files-->70<!--/N--> | <!--N:own.server.text.lines-->23,698<!--/N--> |
| [`mirror/home/auma/seed/`](../mirror/home/auma/seed/) | Auma's starting organs: <!--N:seed.organs-->26<!--/N--> small JavaScript modules under `organs/`. The same organs appear again, stored by content hash, under `mirror/balls/` and `mirror/home/balls/`. | <!--N:own.seed.files-->28<!--/N--> | <!--N:own.seed.text.lines-->7,304<!--/N--> |
| [`packages/experimental/webworker-runtime/src/x6/`](../packages/experimental/webworker-runtime/src/x6/) | The in-browser loader that runs organs from a ball (`ball-loader.ts`), the WebAssembly cell loader in `wasm-cells.ts`, and the scion, the compiler that builds an organ she proposes in a separate worker, in `scion.ts`. | <!--N:own.loader.files-->20<!--/N--> | <!--N:own.loader.text.lines-->13,873<!--/N--> |
| [`packages/client/ui-layout/src/client/spatial/`](../packages/client/ui-layout/src/client/spatial/) | The user interface, which the project calls Spatial. | <!--N:own.spatial.files-->132<!--/N--> | <!--N:own.spatial.text.lines-->37,073<!--/N--> |
| [`apps/web/public/cells/`](../apps/web/public/cells/) | Compiled WebAssembly modules, which the project calls cells. Only `aura-focus.wat` is source; the other <!--N:own.cells.prebuilt.files-->24<!--/N--> cells are binary (see below). | <!--N:own.cells.files-->28<!--/N--> | <!--N:own.cells.text.lines-->769<!--/N--> |

By top folder, the project's own lines are <!--N:top.packages.own.lines-->108,754<!--/N--> in `packages/` (including the two `packages/` folders above), <!--N:top.apps.own.lines-->63,570<!--/N--> in `apps/` (including the cells), <!--N:top.deploy.own.lines-->85,714<!--/N--> in `deploy/`, <!--N:top.server.own.lines-->23,698<!--/N--> in `server/` and <!--N:top.mirror.own.lines-->21,752<!--/N--> in `mirror/`. One data file, `apps/web/public/app/auma/canon-v16.json`, is <!--N:biggest.lines-->29,509<!--/N--> lines, <!--N:biggest.pct-->9.4<!--/N-->% of all the project's lines.

What the project's own lines are: <!--N:kind.tests.pct-->37.6<!--/N-->% tests and test fixtures, <!--N:kind.data.pct-->10.2<!--/N-->% data files (`.json`, `.jsonl`), <!--N:kind.other.pct-->52.2<!--/N-->% code, documents and configuration.

For what this code does and how it is tested, see [`docs/WHAT-IS-BUILT.md`](WHAT-IS-BUILT.md) and [`docs/ARCHITECTURE-ACTUAL.md`](ARCHITECTURE-ACTUAL.md). Words like ball, organ and epoch are in [`docs/GLOSSARY.md`](GLOSSARY.md).

## How it was counted

Each file of the last commit before publication was compared with the upstream starting point by its git blob id (a hash of its bytes). Files rewritten or written at publication are classed by that commit.

- **Inherited unchanged**: the same path with the same bytes as the starting point.
- **Inherited, changed here**: the same path, different bytes. "Lines changed here" is the number of inserted lines git reports for that file between the starting point and the last commit before publication. The rest of the file counts as inherited.
- **Added here**: the path is not in the starting point. Every line counts as this project's. An added file can still hold third-party code; for example [`apps/web/public/app/assets/AURA-TRACE-THIRD-PARTY.txt`](../apps/web/public/app/assets/AURA-TRACE-THIRD-PARTY.txt) names some.
- **Written at publication**: files that the script which produced this public tree wrote itself: licence texts, notices, front pages and the starting records of a fresh node.
- **Vendored**: everything under `vendor/`, plus <!--N:vendored.outside-vendor.files-->4<!--/N--> third-party audio codec files in `apps/web/public/app/assets/`, each named or matched by hash in [`SOURCES.json`](../apps/web/public/app/assets/SOURCES.json).
- **Binary, no source**: files named in a `LICENSE.binaries` note. `aura-focus.wasm` is not in this class, because its source `aura-focus.wat` sits beside it.
- **Other binary**: files with null bytes or that are not UTF-8 text, such as images.
- **Lines** are physical lines of the file as it is in this tree. `wc -l` can give one line less for a file whose last line has no line break. **Code** means files ending in `.ts .tsx .mts .cts .js .jsx .mjs .cjs .py .rs .go .c .h .cpp .sh .wat .css .html .swift .rb`.

Choices that move the numbers, stated so you can weigh them:

- When the tree was published, names, links and placeholders were replaced in <!--N:pub.rewritten.files-->72<!--/N--> inherited files (<!--N:pub.rewritten.lines-->13,881<!--/N--> lines). They are still counted as inherited unchanged.
- Moved files are not followed: a move counts as one removed and one added path. Git finds <!--N:method.renames-->0<!--/N--> renames between the two commits at its default similarity, so this changes nothing today.
- The counts were checked against git's own totals of added and modified paths for the same two commits, and they agree.
- Files of the private node that were left out of this tree (its data, keys, names and history) are not counted anywhere on this page.

What the counts do not say: who or what wrote a line, whether it is good, or whether it is used or tested.

## What you can reproduce

From this tree alone you can check the number of files and text lines in each folder, the list of binary files without source (the `LICENSE.binaries` notes), and the vendored list ([`vendor/README.md`](../vendor/README.md), [`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).

With a clone of the upstream project you can approximate the split. The tree names its address, `https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness`, for example in `native/system/packages/entry/package.json`. Compare each file's blob id (`git hash-object <file>`) with the same path at an upstream commit. Two limits apply. The tree does not record which upstream commit the project started from, so pick the commit that matches the most files byte for byte. And your "changed" count will be higher than the one here, because it also takes in the files rewritten at publication and the files written at publication at paths that exist upstream. This public method has not been run against the real upstream repository: UNVERIFIED.

What you cannot reproduce: the exact split above. It depends on the project's history before publication, which is not public.
